title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning: NewVue Health
scenario: As part of NewVue Health's Phase 2 modernization, you must provision the M365 Business Premium tenant. This assessment validates your ability to navigate the portals, execute specific branding steps, and verify tenant readiness.

activities.title: The Tenant Setup Pipeline
activities.prompt: You have just received your global admin credentials. Arrange these actions in the correct sequence to provision and brand the tenant according to the NewVue requirements.
steps: Sign in to the M365 Admin Center for the first time
Navigate to the 'Billing' section to confirm Business Premium licenses
Open the Entra ID Admin Center to configure Company Branding
Enter the hex code #003D79 for the brand color
Validate via an Incognito browser session
answer: Sign in to the M365 Admin Center for the first time
Navigate to the 'Billing' section to confirm Business Premium licenses
Open the Entra ID Admin Center to configure Company Branding
Enter the hex code #003D79 for the brand color
Validate via an Incognito browser session
activities.explanation: Licensing must be verified before identity configuration; branding requires propagation time before validation will succeed.

activities.title: The 'Admin Center' Junction
activities.prompt: You are in the main M365 Admin Center. Which sequence is required to manage the mobile device enrollment policies for NewVue Health?
options: Show All -> Admin Centers -> Endpoint Management (Intune)
activities.answer: Show All -> Admin Centers -> Endpoint Management (Intune)
activities.explanation: Intune (Endpoint Management) is a separate admin center linked via the main M365 sidebar.
